violation_type.title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))
violation_type.typical_finding: The first aid kit was missing tweezers.

finding_variants.text: The first aid kit was missing tweezers.

The first aid kits were reviewed for the 3 van used. The 1st kit did not have cotton balls, scissors, and a thermometer, the second kit did not have a first aid guide and a thermometer, and third kit did not have a thermometer.
The transportation vehicle had a first aid kit with missing gloves in it.    Note: The gloves were replaced in the first aid kit during the inspection.
I observed that the first aid kit on Bus #2 did not have scissors or tweezers.
There was a thermometer that was missing from the first aid kit located on the bus used to transport children.
The transportation vehicles were missing items from the first aid kit: The vehicles were missing tweezers, a thermometer, and an antiseptic solution.
